verdict.rationale: Lago is a billing and subscription platform, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents free trials, coupons, promotion codes, automatic trial-to-paid conversion, or trial-end notifications. The cited docs cover plan assignment, upgrades and downgrades, invoicing, and webhooks, but none of them address trial or discount mechanics.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run free trials, coupons, and promotion codes with automatic conversion to paid — including trial-end notifications required by card-network rules
